1 <Screen name> — 3 breakpoints (low fidelity, grayscale)
Low-fidelity wireframe — a LAYOUT reference, not an appearance reference.
Source of truth: specs/<NNN-slug>/spec.md. What is taken from it: arrangement, hierarchy, on-screen content and behaviour per breakpoint. What is not: color, grays, type sizes, typeface, iconography — the symbols here (→ ▾ ● ⟳ ☰) are low-fidelity notation, not the icon set.
Every element on this page traces to a requirement in that spec. On any discrepancy the spec wins: the wireframe is corrected, never the other way round.
